categories.main_business_segments: The company operates in building waterproofing as its core business, with segments including waterproof materials sales (防水卷材, 防水涂料), waterproof engineering construction services, seismic isolation and damping products, residential building materials (民用建材), building renovation services (修缮业务), and international business. The company has established a diversified product portfolio covering industrial construction, civil construction, public facilities, and infrastructure projects.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced manufacturing technologies including asphalt-based and high-polymer waterproof membranes, waterproof coatings (polyurethane and water-based), and seismic isolation/damping devices. Production employs intelligent manufacturing systems with IoT integration, APS scheduling systems, MOM manufacturing operations management, and automated warehousing (WMS) and logistics (TMS) systems. The company has developed proprietary root-resistant waterproofing technology and self-adhesive membrane systems.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers include large state-owned enterprises, major real estate developers, general contractors, and industrial enterprises. Key end markets are industrial buildings, residential buildings, public facilities, infrastructure construction, rail transit, airports, nuclear power, water conservancy projects, and photovoltaic roofing. The company also serves the residential renovation market through its consumer-focused brands.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates across mainland China with major production bases in Foshan (Guangdong), Kunshan (Jiangsu), Nantong (Jiangsu), Anshan (Liaoning), Dezhou (Shandong), Chongqing, Weinan (Shaanxi), Jingmen (Hubei), and Sanming (Fujian). Internationally, the company has established operations in Hong Kong, Malaysia, and Cambodia, with strategic focus on Southeast Asia and Belt and Road Initiative countries.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates across multiple supply chain positions: upstream in raw material sourcing (asphalt, polymers, membranes), midstream in manufacturing and processing of waterproofing materials, and downstream in direct sales to end customers and through distribution networks. The company also provides engineering services and installation, positioning it as an integrated solution provider.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include transitioning from product export to brand export, developing green and low-carbon waterproofing solutions, advancing intelligent manufacturing capabilities, expanding into building renovation and urban renewal markets, and strengthening international market presence. R&D focuses on high-performance polymer membranes, environmentally-friendly coatings, seismic isolation technology, and smart construction systems.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue through multiple channels: direct sales of waterproof materials to large enterprises and contractors, distribution through 3,200+ dealers nationwide, engineering and construction services on a project basis, residential building materials through retail and online channels, and building renovation services. Revenue recognition occurs upon product delivery/customer acceptance for materials and based on construction progress for engineering services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading player in China's fragmented waterproofing industry with approximately 3,000+ competitors. Key competitors include other major waterproofing manufacturers. The company differentiates through brand strength (valued at 8.093 billion yuan), technical innovation, comprehensive service offerings, and scale advantages. Market consolidation is accelerating as stricter quality standards and environmental regulations eliminate smaller competitors.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company is a large-scale enterprise with 2024 revenue of 6.83 billion yuan (down 14.04% from 7.94 billion in 2023), reflecting industry headwinds and strategic business restructuring. Net profit attributable to shareholders was 44.07 million yuan (improved from -337.6 million in 2023). Total assets reached 14.04 billion yuan. The company demonstrates resilience with positive operating cash flow of 315.6 million yuan in 2024.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes comprehensive solutions combining high-quality products, technical expertise, and professional services. Key differentiators include: advanced green and low-carbon materials meeting environmental standards, intelligent manufacturing ensuring product consistency, extensive R&D capabilities (500+ researchers, 824 valid patents), professional installation and maintenance services, and integrated solutions addressing building lifecycle needs from construction through renovation. The company positions itself as a trusted partner for building safety and longevity.
